useWhen: A Hot Sheet shell banner needs a full-width status strip above the workspace.
avoidWhen: The feedback belongs inline beside affected work; use Kerf StateBanner directly.

components.name: ProjectSetupWarningBanner
components.purpose: Dismissible warning that a project opened but skipped its setup refresh, with the reason and fix.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs dismissible warning that a project opened but skipped its setup refresh, with the reason and fix.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific ProjectSetupWarningBanner behavior.

components.name: ServerBuildNoticeBanner
components.purpose: Dismissible info strip when a pinned host serves a project through a machine server that differs from its selected build (HS2-46BKH7).

useWhen: Hot Sheet opened a project through a shared machine server that another host or build replaced, and a safe restart was refused, unsupported, or ineffective.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific ServerBuildNoticeBanner behavior.

components.name: SourceStaleNoticeBanner
components.purpose: Dismissible info strip when the workspace source is newer than the running server's build while the client/server pair still matches (HS2-B84P1S).

useWhen: The running server was built from older local source than the workspace, and no client build contradicts the running pair.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific SourceStaleNoticeBanner behavior.

components.name: RepositorySizeBanner
components.purpose: Dismissible project shell strip while any of the project's repositories is over GitHub's 5 GB soft or 10 GB hard size limit, linking to the statistics view (HS2-P1GYWH).

useWhen: The server-computed repository size report for the open project is over a GitHub limit.
avoidWhen: The repository sizes themselves are needed; the statistics view uses RepositorySize.

components.name: NotificationsPausedBanner
components.purpose: App-wide status that notifications are paused, with the waiting request count and Resume.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs app-wide status that notifications are paused, with the waiting request count and Resume.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific NotificationsPausedBanner behavior.

components.name: ProviderIcon
components.purpose: Provider brand marks for GitHub, GitLab, and Jira at the inline (m) and identity (l) sizes.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs provider brand marks for GitHub, GitLab, and Jira at the inline (m) and identity (l) sizes.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific ProviderIcon behavior.

components.name: TicketSourceSetupDialog
components.purpose: Choose and configure a git or external ticket source, including first-source and existing-default choices.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs choose and configure a git or external ticket source, including first-source and existing-default choices.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific TicketSourceSetupDialog behavior.

components.name: ProviderSetupForm
components.purpose: Provider credentials, repository locator, and default-source settings.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs provider credentials, repository locator, and default-source settings.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific ProviderSetupForm behavior.

components.name: TicketSourcesSettings
components.purpose: One project's own ticket sources: default-source choice, editable rows with a remove-from-this-project action, and a note for a source another project shares.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs one project's own ticket sources: default-source choice, editable rows with a remove-from-this-project action, and a note for a source another project shares.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific TicketSourcesSettings behavior.

components.name: AccountsSettings
components.purpose: Machine-wide provider sign-ins with their sources and the projects using each; Sign out for an unused account, plus the empty and error states (App Settings → Accounts).

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs machine-wide provider sign-ins with their sources and the projects using each; Sign out for an unused account, plus the empty and error states (App Settings → Accounts).
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific AccountsSettings behavior.

components.name: SettingsWorkspace
components.purpose: One category-selected project or app settings surface.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs one category-selected project or app settings surface with a centered Kerf List page column.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific SettingsWorkspace behavior.

components.name: KeyboardSettings
components.purpose: Grouped reference and rebinding of documented keyboard shortcuts.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs grouped reference and rebinding of documented keyboard shortcuts.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific KeyboardSettings behavior.

components.name: TrashSettings
components.purpose: Trash retention window with an inline Apply now action, purge-count preview, and unapplied-change warning.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs trash retention window and empty-trash entry point.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific TrashSettings behavior.

components.name: TerminalMemorySettings
components.purpose: Machine-wide terminal history, server replay buffer, and warm-terminal limits with memory-derived defaults (HS2-Y5DYC0).

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs the machine-wide terminal memory limits.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific TerminalMemorySettings behavior.

components.name: PermissionRulesSettings
components.purpose: Three newest remembered permission answers for the current project, with concise duration labels, distinct private action fingerprints, a searchable paged full-list dialog, individual revoke actions, and confirmed bulk edit/delete (HS2-JNHAYB, HS2-16XPHH, HS2-C057G5, HS2-BH6GCG, HS2-Q40BBV).

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs to list a project's remembered permission answers and let the user edit or revoke them individually or in bulk.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific PermissionRulesSettings behavior.

components.name: MainShell
components.purpose: Viewport application shell with header actions forwarded to a Toolbar trailing zone.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs viewport application shell with header actions forwarded to a Toolbar trailing zone.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific MainShell behavior.

components.name: AddProjectAction
components.purpose: The project strip's Add-project action: one native icon button in a single borderless compact ToolbarControlGroup.

obligations: Handle the choose-project action once at the application root.
The icon-only button is named "Add project" with aria-label.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs the project strip's Add-project action: one native icon button in a single borderless compact ToolbarControlGroup.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific AddProjectAction behavior.

components.name: EmptyTrashAction
components.purpose: The Trash view's standalone outlined danger Empty Trash button.

obligations: Handle the open-empty-trash action once at the application root.
The visible "Empty Trash" label names the button.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs the Trash view's standalone outlined danger Empty Trash button.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific EmptyTrashAction behavior.

components.name: ProjectDashboardModes
components.purpose: The project strip's global dashboard switcher: a borderless compact ToolbarControlGroup of native pressed buttons.

obligations: Handle the set-shell-mode action once at the application root.
The group is named "Global dashboards"; each icon-only button carries aria-label and aria-pressed.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs the project strip's global dashboard switcher: a borderless compact ToolbarControlGroup of native pressed buttons.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific ProjectDashboardModes behavior.

components.name: QuickTicketLauncher
components.purpose: The brand pill Kerf Button that opens the quick ticket composer and accepts dropped tickets and files.

obligations: Handle expand-ticket-composer clicks and the new-ticket and duplicate-ticket drop targets once at the application root.
The visible label names the button; the title describes the drop target.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs the brand pill Kerf Button that opens the quick ticket composer and accepts dropped tickets and files.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific QuickTicketLauncher behavior.

components.name: TicketViewAction
components.purpose: Renders the current ticket view's primary action spec as QuickTicketLauncher or EmptyTrashAction.

obligations: The rendered launcher or Empty Trash button carries its own root-wired actions.
Inherits the rendered button’s visible label.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs renders the current ticket view's primary action spec as QuickTicketLauncher or EmptyTrashAction.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific TicketViewAction behavior.

components.name: WorkspaceControls
components.purpose: Workspace view-mode, sort, selection, ticket search, and overflow control groups rendered as Toolbar zone content with no wrapper element.

state.id: view mode, sort, selection, and search state

obligations: Wire the workspace search, sort, overflow, and selection actions once at the application root.

behaviors: Sort, selection, and view-mode groups yield to the overflow group at narrow toolbar container widths; an expanded search takes the row.

obligations: Each group names its controls; the overflow trigger is named and keyboard-openable.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs workspace view-mode, sort, selection, ticket search, and overflow control groups rendered as Toolbar zone content with no wrapper element.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific WorkspaceControls behavior.

components.name: WorkspaceIdentity
components.purpose: The project name as Toolbar leading text, hidden at the narrowest toolbar widths.

behaviors: Hidden below the 224px toolbar container width so an expanded search keeps the row.

obligations: May carry the page heading level and id when it is the page title.

useWhen: Hot Sheet needs the project name as Toolbar leading text, hidden at the narrowest toolbar widths.
avoidWhen: The interaction does not need Hot Sheet's domain-specific WorkspaceIdentity behavior.
